_review: DRAFT v1 — colony effects require MarketAPI/Industry handler hooks. Numbers untuned. Administered-only filter unimplemented.

nodes.name: Colony Management
nodes._review: Handler must identify 'administered' colonies — currently vague. Assume player-faction markets with admin.

nodes.name: Bureaucracy
nodes.desc: +1 max colony size governed personally by you.
nodes._review: Vanilla Hypercognition gives +1 size; stack means +2 total. Likely over-strong.

nodes.name: Industrial Planning
nodes._review: 5% is marginal at early colony; scales with # of industries. Keep.

nodes.name: Mass Production
nodes._review: +1 flat is vanilla Industrial Planning-level. Confirm industry IDs match vanilla constants.

nodes.name: AI Cores
nodes.desc: -25% upkeep penalty when using AI cores on administered colonies.
nodes._review: AI core penalty reduction — handler must read market's admin flag for faction rep impact. Thematic.

nodes.name: Industrial Empire
nodes._review: +1 industry slot is biggest colony-cap change vanilla offers. Strong capstone.

nodes.name: Trade Networks
nodes._review: Handler hooks EconomyAPI monthly report. Effect key TBD based on actual API.

nodes.name: Accessibility
nodes._review: Accessibility is a market stat (getAccessibility) — handler modifies getAccessibilityMod.

nodes.name: Black Market Connections
nodes.desc: -50% reputation impact from black market trading.
nodes._review: Vanilla Black Market (Contacts) gives this. Thematic overlap — consider niche only.

nodes.name: Merchant Prince
nodes._review: Stacks with trade_1 and trade_3. Income from 3-colony empire could hit +50% — tune.

nodes.name: Civil Administration
nodes._review: Vanilla Hypercognition gives +2. Keep this at +1 as prerequisite tier.

nodes.name: Patrol Doctrine
nodes.desc: +1 patrol fleet strength on administered colonies.
nodes._review: Effect spec unclear — 'patrol strength' not a direct MarketAPI stat. May need Industry-level handler.

nodes.name: Intelligence Network
nodes.desc: +5% to all intel events resolved in your favor.
nodes._review: 'Intel bonus' vague — handler could read bar events, raids, or faction quests. Scope TBD.

nodes.name: Political Mastermind
nodes.desc: Administered colonies: +2 stability, immune to growth penalties from low relations. (Capstone)
nodes._review: Immunity effect is binary — handler spec different from amount-based stats. Design before implementing.
